pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal dark regions with predominantly sharp-angled vertices and linear edge segments. Spatial area of patches is highest on the neck and shoulder, decreasing in size and becoming more rounded toward the hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light-toned interstitial pathways. Intersections are characterized by tri-way and four-way junction nodes. Pixel thickness remains relatively uniform across the mid-flank with slight broadening at nodal points.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged profile along the upper neck mane, presenting a distinct serrated silhouette against the background.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A visible structural discontinuity in the mane profile located at the transition zone between the distal neck and the anterior shoulder ridge.
